spans.s:
ātmaka, for ātman in mg 4 at end of cpds
[1222, 1307]; e. g. māra_ātmaka, murder-natured,
 murderous.

ātma-prabha, a. having his or their
own splendor. [prabhā, 354.]

ātma-bhava, m. the coming into existence
of one's self.

ātmavát, adv. as one's self. [ātma, i. e.
ātman: 1107.]

ātma-saṃdeha, m. danger of one's self,
personal risk.

ātmaupamya, n. likeness to one's self,
i. e. a putting one's self in another's place.
[aupamya.]
